I’m really worried about the message we’re sending to all the new players who joined for Midnight. I have three friends who just started their subs last week, and they’re already asking me why they can’t play on their only day off.

It makes the community look ‘unprofessional’ when other modern MMOs have almost zero downtime. Does Blizzard not realize they are literally driving people back to other games? It breaks my heart to see the player count potentially drop because of this.
